rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial insult for a Korean person, especially when the speaker is being contemptuous.

example.english: I don't want to do business with that gook.
example.traditional: 我唔想同嗰個韓國佬做生意。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 go2 go3 hon4 gwok3 lou2 zou6 saang1 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the Korean person meant is specifically North Korean, including in a Korean War context.

example.english: That North Korean was a gook captured during the war.
example.traditional: 嗰個北韓佬係戰爭期間俾人捉到嘅。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 bak1 hon4 lou2 hai6 zin3 zang1 kei4 gaan1 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3 ge3

rows.note: Use this strongly derogatory term for Koreans when the explicitly ethnic-slur force matters more than everyday Cantonese phrasing.

example.english: This newspaper actually used the slur gook for Koreans and was heavily criticized.
example.traditional: 呢份報紙竟然用「高麗棒子」稱呼韓國人，俾人鬧到臭。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 zi2 ging2 jin4 jung6 gou1 lai6 paang5 zi2 cing1 fu1 hon4 gwok3 jan4 bei2 jan4 naau6 dou2 cau3
